**Chosen Foods** is widely considered the best overall brand because independent studies (such as those from UC Davis) verify it as 100% pure avocado oil without rancidity or adulteration. Other top-tier alternatives include **Marianne's** (noted for purity awards), **Avohass** (best cold-pressed), and **Olivado** (pioneer of extra virgin). [](https://olivado.com/extra-virgin-avocado-oil-best-in-world)

-   **Chosen Foods:** Best overall for purity, high smoke point (500°F), and widespread availability.

-   **Marianne's:** Excellent high-heat stability, third-party tested, and Clean Label Project Purity Award winner.

-   **Avohass:** Premium choice for unrefined, cold-pressed extra virgin flavor.

-   **Olivado:**

High-end extra virgin producer with great traceability and rich taste.

-   **BetterBody Foods:** Popular, budget-friendly option for everyday high-heat cooking. [](https://olivado.com/extra-virgin-avocado-oil-best-in-world)

### What to Look For

-   **Purity Testing:** Choose brands that publish third-party quality or purity lab results, as studies show many commercial oils are rancid or mixed with cheaper oils.

-   **Extraction Method:** Cold-pressed or unrefined options retain more nutrients and flavor, while refined oils suit very high-heat frying.

-   **Packaging:** Dark glass bottles protect the oil from light damage and oxidation. [](https://www.amazon.in/HOFFMAN-Pressed-Unrefined-Roasting-Sauteing/dp/B0DNFTGV9V)
